set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/empty-home
trap 'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /out/memory-events.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /out/memory-peak.txt' EXIT
rustc -Vv > /out/rustc.txt
result=0
cargo fmt --all -- --check > /out/fmt.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/fmt.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --all-targets --no-fail-fast > /out/full.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/full.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-features --all-targets > /out/clippy.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/clippy.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
exit $result
